GOOD QUESTIONS

A little more clarity.

Which classes and boards do you teach?+

Our tuition programmes support classes 8 to 12 across CBSE and State Board. Contact the team to confirm the subjects and batches available for your class.

Can I learn online or at a centre?+

Yes. Smartup offers online programmes as well as classroom tuition at centres across Kochi. The team can help you find the format that fits your needs.

How do you support students beyond classes?+

Our academic approach includes regular practice, doubt discussions, assessments and progress monitoring. Mentorship and parent meeting frequency vary by programme.

How can I find out about fees and admissions?+

Call +91 88919 10919 or contact your nearest centre. The team will explain the relevant programme, fees, payment options and current batch availability.
